GetVer.text: The program's version as text from the constants in consts: "v major.minor", plus a letter when the revision is not 0 (1 = a, 2 = b ...).

GetVerEx.text: Describes the operating system: on Windows "Microsoft Windows" and the release name that matches the build number (from the W_VER table); on Linux the values read from /etc/os-release (pretty name, version, and so on) with their quotation marks removed, kept in L_VER. Other systems give an empty string.
